caption:
Your hiragana and katakana, as a font ✍️

1️⃣ Open font.315tools.com and pick Japanese kana (120 boxes)
2️⃣ Write on a printed sheet or straight on screen
3️⃣ Press Make font and install the .ttf file

A fun project if you are learning Japanese. Your handwriting stays on your device.
